description: This file provides utility functions for handling sparse matrices, including conversions between formats, loading datasets, generating random tensors, and handling sparse matrix operations for benchmarking DLMC (Deep Learning Matrix Collection) datasets related to sparse matrix computations such as SpMV, SpMM, and matrix multiplication.

methods.name: to_coo_scipy(x)
methods.description: Converts a PyTorch sparse tensor to a SciPy COO sparse matrix.

methods.name: sparse_grad_output(a, b)
methods.description: Generates a gradient output tensor for sparse matrix operations, either sparse or dense.

methods.name: read_matrix_params(path)
methods.description: Reads matrix dimensions and the number of non-zero elements from a file.

methods.name: csr_to_coo(indices, indptr, shape)
methods.description: Converts CSR format indices and indptr arrays to a COO coordinate tensor.

methods.name: load_sparse_matrix(path, device)
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix in CSR format from a file into a PyTorch sparse tensor.

methods.name: gen_vector(path, device)
methods.description: Generates a dense vector of random values from a file.

methods.name: gen_matrix(path, device)
methods.description: Generates a dense matrix of random values from a file.

methods.name: load_spmv_dataset(dataset_path, hidden_size, sparsity, device, n_limit=math.inf)
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix-vector multiplication dataset for benchmarking.

methods.name: load_spmm_dataset( dataset_path, hidden_size, sparsity, spmm_type, device, n_limit=math.inf )
methods.description: Loads a sparse matrix-matrix multiplication dataset.

methods.name: load_dlmc_dataset( dataset_path, operation, hidden_size, sparsity, device, requires_grad, n_limit=math.inf, )
methods.description: Loads DLMC datasets for different sparse matrix operations, supporting various dataset types and configurations.

ctags.name: load_dlmc_dataset
ctags.signature: ( dataset_path, operation, hidden_size, sparsity, device, requires_grad, n_limit=math.inf, )

ctags.name: load_spmm_dataset
ctags.signature: ( dataset_path, hidden_size, sparsity, spmm_type, device, n_limit=math.inf )
